description: Read 2 to 5 pages whose URLs you already know in one call, each as clean Markdown with title and description, fetched in parallel. Cheaper and faster than calling web-scrape once per URL. A failed page is reported with its error while the others still return; charged only if at least one page was read. To find URLs first, use site-map (one site) or search-read (a question). Params: urls (1 to 5, required), max_chars per page (500 to 30000, default 6000). Price: $0.015 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"urls":["https://agentsvc.io/","https://agentsvc.io/docs"],"max_chars":3000}.
name: web_read_batch
title: Web Read Batch
